## Definition

For an Adyen point-of-sale integration, store administration uses the Management API to retrieve, create, and update merchant-associated stores and to configure their payment methods. This is distinct from Terminal API payment messaging.

## Operational boundary

The 2026-09-15 Adyen guide uses a platform-unique store ID for store updates; a human-readable reference is unique only within its merchant account. New stores start active without payment methods, and terminals still need assignment and boarding to transact. Inactive stores block new transactions while outstanding captures remain possible. Closing requires an inactive store, moves its terminals to merchant inventory immediately, and cannot be undone; terminals must be reassigned and boarded to process again. See the source for credential roles, endpoint scope, regional fields, payment-method caveats, live rate limits, and versioned examples.
